# Duartes Auto Detailing

> Mobile auto detailing for vehicles in the Bay Area, including Alameda, Berkeley, Castro Valley, Dublin, Fremont, Hayward, Livermore, Oakland, Palo Alto, Pleasanton, Richmond, San Francisco, San Jose, San Leandro, San Mateo, Union City, and Walnut Creek.

Duartes Auto Detailing provides mobile appointments at a suitable home, office, or private garage when safe vehicle access and working space are available. Availability depends on the service, location, schedule, vehicle condition, and access details. Configured daily hours are 06:00–20:00. Phone: +1 (669) 286-8649.

## Primary Business Pages

- [Home](https://duartesautodetailing.com/): Mobile auto detailing overview for Bay Area vehicles.
- [About Duartes Auto Detailing](https://duartesautodetailing.com/about/): Background on the business and its mobile detailing approach.
- [Contact Duartes Auto Detailing](https://duartesautodetailing.com/contact/): Contact options for Bay Area mobile detailing appointments.
- [Mobile Auto Detailing Services](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/): Catalog of available mobile detailing services.

## Services

- [Interior Detail](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/interior-detailing/): Interior cleaning and conditioning for cabin surfaces, carpets, mats, glass, and trim.
- [Exterior Detail](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/exterior-detailing/): Exterior care for paint, wheels, tires, glass, and trim.
- [Paint Correction](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/paint-correction/): Machine polishing for paint with swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation, water spots, or dullness after evaluation.
- [Ceramic Coating](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/ceramic-coating/): Paint protection option focused on gloss and easier maintenance.
- [Full Detail (Interior - Exterior)](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/full-detailing/): Combined interior and exterior detailing service.
- [Seat & Upholstery Deep Cleaning](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/seat-upholstery-deep-cleaning/): Deep cleaning for cloth seats, carpets, mats, and fabric upholstery.
- [Headlight Restoration](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/headlight-restoration/): Restoration service for cloudy, yellowed, or oxidized headlight lenses.
- [Clay Bar Decontamination](https://duartesautodetailing.com/services/clay-bar-decontamination/): Removal of bonded paint contamination that regular washing does not remove.
